description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways -  Order to amend the Gazette Ex. No. 281/7 of 24.01.1984 by adding Faculty of Allied Health Sciences to the University of Ruhuna
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule establishing the University of Ruhuna by adding new faculties and departments. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending the legal framework governing universities rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes.
